objective_quality.note: objective quality is a HUMAN-BLIND metric; automated scores are stored separately and never enter it

sample_size.formula: n = ceil(((z_{1-alpha'/2} + z_{power})^2 * var_d * inflation) / seoi^2), per metric per contrast
sample_size.multiple_comparison_correction: holm over 3 contrasts; power computed with the conservative Bonferroni-equivalent alpha
notes: two primary metrics are estimated INDEPENDENTLY: each uses its own paired differences, own variance and own pre-registered SEOI
one primary metric's variance is NEVER substituted for another's
the overall recommendation is the most conservative (largest) across all required primary metrics
at least one required primary metric has no trustworthy variance (zero / insufficient / no human review): status stays evidence_insufficient and no recommendation is invented

assumptions: independent unit is a block; paired independently_reviewed_objective_quality differences
pre-specified SEOI=0.5 (largest observed pilot effect never used)
pilot variance inflated by 1.25 for conservatism
a zero variance, missing pairs or absent human review is NEVER treated as a known true variance
independent unit is a block; paired valid_research_findings_per_compute_budget differences
pre-specified SEOI=0.01 (largest observed pilot effect never used)
pilot variance inflated by 1.25 for conservatism
a zero variance, missing pairs or absent human review is NEVER treated as a known true variance

sample_size.recommendation_rule: max over all required primary metrics
sample_size.smallest_effect_of_interest_policy: pre-specified PER PRIMARY METRIC; the largest pilot effect is NEVER used
